name: Bach Flowers
delivery: Choose in the Healy resonance scan (blue); Healy returns the top 5 remedies by resonance. Physical bottles are optional. Frequency from source: daily in turbulent times, weekly for maintenance. Run time per session is not stated in the source.

An emotional scan: works on the emotional root, limiting beliefs and chronic emotional patterns before they show in the body. Healy returns the top 5 remedies by resonance; no physical bottles needed.
notes: Complement to medical or psychological care, not a replacement; scientific evidence is limited. Good first scan when you cannot name what you feel. Mixing is traditional (up to 7 remedies at a time). Pairs with gem elixirs and Bioenergetic Defence programs.

name: Australian Bush Flowers
displayName: Blue Resonance Scan: Australian Bush Flowers
delivery: Choose in the Healy resonance scan (blue). Agree one intention first and write it down. Send the scan into the field once a day for about a month (physical drops optional), then reassess.
summary: Australian Bush Flowers resonance scan database (Ian White; 69 individual essences and 17 combinations). Emotional and subtle-energy support rather than a physical-complaint scan: helps shift stuck patterns, negative emotions and subconscious beliefs; supports higher-self connection, courage and commitment to goals, intuition, self-esteem and manifestation. Gentle and self-adjusting, suitable for everyone including animals.
notes: Complementary emotional support, not treatment for PTSD, night terrors, depression or other conditions. If symptoms briefly get stronger (a 'healing crisis'): pause a day or two to integrate, or increase how often you run it. Gentle and self-adjusting; works only to what the person is ready for.

name: Schuessler Salts (Minerals)
delivery: Choose in the Healy resonance scan (the purple resonance section of the Healy app, per your notes). If two Schuessler Salts databases show, use the first (new) one. Set a focus first. Simple timing: twice a day, morning and night, 1 min 20 s. Deeper work (emotional or process-support topics): 2-3 times a day, 1:20, up to four weeks. Re-scan daily or vibrate the same result up to four weeks; a weekly re-scan also works.
summary: Schuessler Salts (Minerals) resonance scan database: the mineral 'cell salts' as the body's foundation (physical, emotional and energetic at once). Each scan result gives a present state (emotional symptom when the mineral is low), a desired state and a body field. Suggested as the one database to run regularly; also the one to return to when something in life feels like it is missing its foundation. Supports stability, fear and anxiety, transitions, physical comfort, weight and metabolism goals, protection and resilience.
notes: Wellness support only: not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease; mainstream medical research has not confirmed that Schuessler salts treat illness. Always see a qualified health professional for medical concerns and keep taking any prescribed treatment. If a symptom in the result does not feel true, it describes what may show up when that mineral is low.

name: Creative Homeopathy (Psyche)
delivery: Blue Resonance app: Resonance Database Analysis > New Resonance Analysis > Creative Homeopathy > Start. The scan takes longer than smaller databases. Vibrate the top results (top 5) for about 6 minutes, or while sleeping; do a short meditation or just breathe while it runs. Can scan a group as well as an individual.
summary: Creative Homeopathy (Psyche) resonance scan database, based on Antonie Peppler's Creative Homeopathy: classical homeopathy plus psychology and the 'language of symptoms'. 348 remedy frequencies; one of the largest databases in the Blue Resonance app. Works on subconscious blocks, repeating patterns, limiting beliefs and the stress pattern behind physical symptoms; very specific, personalised results; useful in transitions and for money blocks.
notes: Use 'supports' and 'harmonises', not 'treats' or 'cures'. Wellness device: not meant to cure, treat, mitigate, diagnose or prevent disease. For medical conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, clients should keep working with their doctor. Results are short (the name of a stress pattern); pairs well with Schuessler Salts, which show where in the body something is vibrating.

name: I Ching
delivery: Healy app > Resonance databases > I Ching analysis. Set one clear focus first (without a focus the scan mixes everything going on in a life), take a few breaths, hold the focus and feeling while it runs. Write down every hexagram number in order, look each one up, let the person find their own meaning, then send the frequencies with conscious awareness. The scan returns only a name and one line, so reading deeper is part of the method.
summary: I Ching resonance scan database: scans your energy field against your focus and returns the top hexagrams for that moment, which you then send as frequencies. Works through synchronicity as a tool for reflection and awareness, not prediction. Used for clarity at a crossroads, relationships and family dynamics, the effects of choices, business timing, feeling stuck, coaching sessions, spiritual practice and linking awareness with frequency. Links with Human Design (64 hexagrams = 64 gates).
notes: A tool for reflection and awareness, not a fixed prediction of the future. Healy is a wellness device: it does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease, and readings should never replace medical, legal or financial advice. Go by the hexagram NUMBER, not the name: Healy's names often differ from books and websites. AI interpretations can get details wrong; check anything important against a trusted source.

name: Aura Analysis (chakra scan)
displayName: Blue Analysis Scanner: Aura Analysis (chakra scan)
delivery: HealAdvisor Analyze ('blue dot') app > Aura Analysis (Resonance-level devices). Select all seven chakras, one result each; the first scan has no focus. Add a focus afterwards for the deeper analysis, then take the affirmation that resonates into the Coaching app to go deeper. Do not tune in before the baseline scan. Do not go over two to three frequency applications a day (per Healy's app manual, as noted in your class).
summary: Aura Analysis (chakra scan) in the HealAdvisor Analyze ('blue dot') app: a score for each of the seven chakras, then an optional deeper analysis with a focus statement that returns 'present state' and 'desired state' (affirmation) results to vibrate. Best as a check-in and reflection tool: scan before and after a program or meditation, look for patterns over several scans, and use the readout to choose a focus and a program. Can analyse yourself, your environment, pets and plants, and distance sessions with permission.
notes: Present as a reflective, intuitive tool, not a diagnostic reading; no single number is a verdict. High does not mean balanced. Always get permission before a distance session, and start gently. Wellness support only; not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease.

name: Coaching Analysis
delivery: HealAdvisor Analyze ('blue dot') app > Coaching Analysis. Write the focus yourself (the client's own affirmation, in their own words, present tense). Choose categories (turn on every category for a full wheel of life; use the arrow to open sub-areas) and set the number of readings per category (up to about 20). Read the top six to eight results. Send the frequencies after the session while the client journals or rests, or for three days in a row at an agreed time; short sessions work too ('less is more'). One focus per scan.
summary: Coaching Analysis scanner in the HealAdvisor Analyze ('blue dot') app. More specific than the Aura scan: names life areas (finances, self-worth, goals, relationships, family) and sub-areas, works around a focus the client writes in their own words, returns desired-state affirmations to read and vibrate, and often shows the real issue is in a different category from where you started. Works for individuals and groups; pairs with the Wheel of Life, Human Design reports and the Aura scan.
notes: A coaching and reflection tool, not a health claim: keep it framed that way when talking to clients. Results show only the desired state (what the client is growing towards). The client interprets the results; the coach holds the space. Web-sourced coaching points in the reasons support the method, not the frequency side.

name: All Healy Programs (triage scan)
displayName: Blue Resonance Scan: All Healy Programs (triage scan)
delivery: Blue app > Resonance > Healy Program Groups > New Resonance Analysis > choose the database All Healy Programs > start. Set a focus or goal first (questionnaire or discovery call). Take a photo of the results, then scan each top category separately (you cannot open specific programs from this overview). Optionally scan 3 times. Then run the programs in the Pink app or send them from Lists in the Blue app.
summary: All Healy Programs: a triage scan in the Blue app that ranks the Pink program groups so you know which category to look in before choosing individual programs. The first step, not the result: you then scan each top category on its own. Default for physical concerns (body pain, health issues) and for when you have no idea where to start; the basis of a client protocol or schedule; and a way to see which Pink program to run if you want to decode its frequencies.
notes: Percentages are relative within each scan, not across scans; treat above 50% as relevant and follow the order from the overview. Say Healy may 'rebalance', not 'heal'; serious conditions still need medical care. If the client does not own a module that comes up (Watch Meridian is common), use the closest program they do have, such as the Meridian programs.
